templateOptions.label: BaseUrl
templateOptions.description: The base URL of the API

templateOptions.label: ClientId
templateOptions.description: The client ID used for API authentication

templateOptions.label: ClientSecret
templateOptions.description: The client secret used for API authentication

templateOptions.label: HistoricalDays
templateOptions.description: The number of days in the past from which expired certificates will be imported

templateOptions.label: Required Certificates Only
templateOptions.description: When toggled, only required certificates will be imported

templateOptions.label: Compliant Certificates Only
templateOptions.description: When toggled, only certificates that have been achieved will be imported. Required certificates (within HistoricalDays) that have NOT been achieved are filtered out. Certificates achieved in the past (even if expired) are still imported as long as the required certificate falls within HistoricalDays. This option automatically implies required certificates only

templateOptions.label: Include Certificate Codes
templateOptions.description: Comma-separated allowlist of certificate codes to import. When empty, all certificates (subject to other filters) are imported. When specified, ONLY these certificate codes will be processed. Example: CE-0001,CE-0002,CE-0003
